question: The Indian National Congress was established when_____ delegates from all over the country met at Bombay in December 1885.
solution:
The correct answer is __**72**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **On 28 December 1885,** the **Indian National Congress** was **founded at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College in Bombay, **with **72 delegates **in attendance.
 
• The founder of the INC was **Allan Octavian Hume**. It was founded in **Mumbai**.
 
• It was formed when **72 delegates **from all the **presidencies **and **provinces **of **India **met at **Bombay from 28 to 30 December 1885.**
 
• **Allan Octavian Hume played** a** leading role** in the **formation** of the **Congress **and acted as its General Secretary&l
